protein_paws_reference_gap_cleaned.train_role: Archived only; forward classifiers are fine-tuned on pawsx_clean/train.

standard_reference.train_role: Historical target-supervised feature baseline, not English-to-protein FT.

scope_remote_identity_matched.direction: Frozen original full-validation polarity; no subset reselection.

expanded_highest_band.test_definition: Unchanged original1000 followed by additional new1000; not an entirely new blind test.

limitations: Exact source/weight identities and representative public loading verified; not all experiments retrained from public-only inputs
English web text and reversible English bins reconstructed from pinned upstream sources
Fine-tuning seeds and same-seed recipe replays are not independent pretraining replication
The five English relatedness configurations contain reconstruction metadata, not directly usable sequence strings
The legacy Reference protein train split is archival; its English-to-protein condition uses 49258 PAWS-X FT rows
Reference hyphen removal retains fragments, self-pairs, duplicates and documented split overlap
The expanded 2000-pair target reuses the original 1000-pair confirmation set and does not replace the original 544/1000 pretraining-comparison targets
The task-data completion does not publish PP or whole-network random-control weights

local_only_weights_not_uploaded_by_task_.scope: These are known local follow-up weights, not part of the 313-file published model bank; this is not an exhaustive claim about every historical artifact.
